### New in 1.4.34
- **The Keybinds list fills its tab** — the tab had been made the right height, but the list inside it still stopped after six rows and left the bottom third of the page empty. It now takes whatever room the page has and scrolls inside it
- **The eyedropper is a crosshair again** — the magnifier and its ring are gone. The full-screen picking window carries the stock crosshair, and the swatch at the panel edge still shows the color under the pointer
- **Country flags on the world clock** — every city leads with a round flag in both the clock and the Add picker, followed by the city and its UTC offset, with the clock reading on the right. A zone with no single country (UTC) keeps an empty circle
